clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Ormak Grimshot trains hunters for life in the wild. Beside his wolf, Grimfang, he teaches Horde hunters to track, shoot, and tame beasts.

Ormak Grimshot trains Horde trackers and marksmen in the Hunter's Hall. With his wolf, Grimfang, at his side, he teaches the skills needed to survive Kalimdor's wilderness. Orc and troll hunters who have completed their trials in Durotar learn from him how to tame and command wild beasts, and to form a lasting bond with an animal companion.
